method.selection: per algorithm, the learning rate in lr_grid with the lowest mean final gap over seeds [0, 1, 2] at that algorithm's default budget, against the common target pi*_beta (rule_lr); the comparison runs at comparison_lr, which is rule_lr except for grpo (see grpo_rate_exception)
method.seed_note: when the seeds are the same, the comparison's reported means are those the selection minimised, so they are slightly optimistic
method.grid_edge_note: grid_edge describes the rate the lowest-final-gap rule picked

feedback_units.dpo: labelled preference pairs (constant over a run)
feedback_units.ppo_rm: reward-model calls; the model was fitted on n_pairs labelled pairs

grpo_rate_exception.reason: published grpo runs at 0.0003, the rate chosen for grpo_ppo_like, not at 0.0001, the rate the lowest-final-gap rule picks for it. Published GRPO does not aim at pi*_beta, so the rule picks whichever rate gets least far within the budget; at one shared rate the two GRPO variants differ only in their two switches (std_normalize, kl_in)

method.points: final gap of dpo and ppo_rm at each n_pairs in PAIR_COUNTS, one entry per seed
